a: $6,000 from NSERC plus host-institution top-up; 14–16 weeks full-time
dt: Each university sets its own internal deadline (typically winter for summer 2027); check your USRA liaison
e: Canadian citizens, permanent residents or protected persons only. Funds a summer research placement at a Canadian university, e.g. in a pulsar, CHIME or NANOGrav group.
unv: No 2026–27 cycle dates on the NSERC page; institutional deadlines vary
